items.author: GatorBait Staff
items.title: Witten Off? Oklahoma's New Play-Caller vs. the Gators' Pass Rush (Scouting Oklahoma, Part 1)
items.dek: Oklahoma ranks 108th in scoring and 111th in total offense, and interim coordinator Jason Witten calls his first game at No. 24 Florida on Saturday. Part 1 of our scouting series: John Mateer, Rocky Beers and former Gator Hayden Hansen against a Gators defense with 23 sacks.

image.alt: Florida's defense huddles during the game at Auburn on Sept. 19, 2026.
image.credit: Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media.

items.author: GatorBait Staff
items.title: Baugh Meets the Stone Wall: Florida's Offense vs. Oklahoma's Defense (Scouting Oklahoma, Part 2)
items.dek: Florida averaged 53.5 points in its first four games and 17.8 in its last four. Part 2 of our Oklahoma scouting series: Jadan Baugh, a quarterback decision and a reshuffled offensive line against a Sooners defense that ranks seventh nationally on third down.

image.alt: Florida's offense lines up against South Carolina at Ben Hill Griffin Stadium on Oct. 10, 2026. Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media.
image.credit: Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media.

items.author: GatorBait Staff
items.title: Gators No. 24 in First CFP Top 25 as Miami, Georgia Lead the Way
items.dek: Florida (5-3) is No. 24 in the first College Football Playoff rankings, one of 10 SEC teams in the Top 25. Miami, Georgia, Utah and Indiana hold the top four spots.

image.alt: Graphic: Gators No. 24 in the first College Football Playoff Top 25, Nov. 3, 2026. Florida is 5-3 and one of 10 SEC teams ranked; Oklahoma visits Saturday at 7:45 p.m. ET on SEC Network.
